headline: Warden Rebound in Nevish Line as Colonials Sweep Marban Hollow
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the front lines have convulsed with sudden reversals across several sectors. Along the Nevish Line, a fierce Warden counter-thrust rolled back recent Colonial gains, consolidating seven bases under Warden control and leaving Colonials with a solitary redoubt amid five rapid base actions. Conversely, Marban Hollow witnessed a dramatic Colonial breakthrough, shattering the previous territorial parity to secure six bastions against a lone Warden stronghold following four transfers at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. In Linn of Mercy, Colonial forces extinguished the remaining Warden garrison to take ten bases alongside one neutral ruin, even as casualty rates slackened. Weathered Expanse saw Wardens clear out all Colonial footholds to hold seven bases and two vacant parcels, marked by continued skirmishing at Crow's Nest. Wardens also re-established a presence on Stlican Shelf, claiming one base against eight Colonial holdings. Meanwhile, fresh demolitions neutralized The Reach in Stonecradle and Transient Valley in Farranac Coast, and Callahan's Passage endured mounting bloodletting along an unmoving border.
